results.q: the game is really stuttering and skipping around the whole time I am trying to play it
results.tip: Give the game a minute after launch -- shaders compiling for the first time cause stutter that goes away.

results.q: no sound at all coming out
results.tip: If there is no sound at all, check the in-game audio settings too, not just the Deck's.

results.q: storage full cant install anything else
results.tip: Internal storage full: uninstall large shaders and unused games first.
If the screen looks torn while moving the camera, turn on V-Sync in the game's display settings.

results.q: it gets really hot and battery drains so fast
results.tip: Lower the TDP limit in Quick Settings if the Deck feels hot or the fan is loud.

results.q: it gets uncomfortably warm in my hands after a little while and the battery seems to drain a lot quicker than it used to
results.tip: TDP cap in QAM affects CPU/GPU together; lowering reduces heat.
SteamOS update stuck: reboot and retry; recovery image if boot loop.

results.q: when I plug it into the television the menus show up in the wrong spot on the screen and are hard to read
results.tip: Big Picture Mode is default on Deck; Desktop Mode for Konsole and file fixes.
